title: Vitamin D Deficiency — Is There Really a Pandemic? | New England Journal of Medicine
abstract: # Vitamin D Deficiency — Is There Really a Pandemic? Manson, M.D., Dr.P.H., Patsy M. Brannon, Ph.D., R.D., Clifford J. Rosen, M.D., and Christine L. For permission requests, please contact NEJM Reprints at. The claim that large proportions of North American and other populations are deficient in vitamin D is based on misinterpretation and misapplication of the Institute of Medicine reference values for nutrients — misunderstandings that can adversely affect patient care. Drs. Manson, Brannon, and Rosen report being members of the Institute of Medicine Committee on Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin D and Calcium, 2009–2011; Dr. Taylor reports serving as IOM study director for the committee.
